comment: Calibration fixture for the real-MiniLM matching test. paraphrases: honest interviewer rewordings of seed questions — the matcher must put the right entry on top at ambiguous or better. offBank: questions the bank does not cover — must classify none. triggerAbuse: statements/questions that merely brush against trigger phrases — must never classify confident.

paraphrases.text: Describe the toughest people issue you've ever had to sort out.
Can you give me an example of a really messy employee situation you managed?
Tell me about pushing back on someone senior and actually winning them over.
Have you ever changed a leader's mind when you thought they were wrong?
What's an error you made at work that genuinely cost something?
Tell me about a time you got it badly wrong.
When everything lands on your desk at the same time, how do you decide what happens first?
How do you juggle several urgent people issues in the same week?
Tell me about working with a stakeholder who was really hard to deal with.
What are your steps when someone brings you a workplace harassment allegation?
Take me through your investigation process, from complaint to outcome.
What if someone confides a serious harassment complaint but begs you to keep it quiet?
How would you react if someone reported retaliation by their manager?
Walk me through your immediate response to a retaliation concern.
How do you help a manager whose team keeps quitting on them?
What do you do when a manager is overworking their team into the ground?
Tell me about a firing that got complicated.
Describe a dismissal that didn't go smoothly.
How do you keep policies consistent when every region has different employment law?
Tell me about launching a change nobody wanted.
How did you handle introducing an unpopular rule?
If an executive pressured you to make an exception to the rules, what would you do?
How would you respond if leadership asked you to look the other way?
Why do you want to work with us specifically?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
What are your long-term goals in HR?

offBank.text: So, um, tell me a little about yourself and your background.
What salary range are you looking for in this role?
Do you have any questions for us?
How was your weekend — ready to get started?

triggerAbuse.text: We're not asking you to bend the rules here, just to be pragmatic about the timeline.
Harassment complaint numbers are down across the industry, which is interesting context.
Five tears in this job would break anyone, as my old boss used to say.
Tell us why you left your last role.

statements.text: I see from your CV that you handled a difficult employee relations case at your last company.
We had a manager burning out their team last year — it was a mess, honestly.

mangledComment: What the transcriber actually hands the matcher. Whisper drops terminal question marks, runs two sentences together, swallows disfluencies into the text and mishears low-frequency words. These are INVARIANTS against the clean wording in the same row — never new absolute bars — so a red here says the transcript is what broke the match, not that the clean fixture needs retuning.
